license_required.quote: No person shall engage in the practice of podiatry or hold himself or herself out to the public in this State as being qualified to practice podiatry

issuing_authority.quote: "Board" shall mean the State Board of Podiatry established in this chapter.

degree_required.quote: Has received a degree of "Doctor of Podiatric Medicine" or its equivalent from a college or school approved by the Council on Podiatric Education of the American Podiatric Medical Association
degree_required.citation: § 508. Qualifications of applicant; report to Attorney General; judicial review.

accrediting_body.value: Council on Podiatric Education of the American Podiatric Medical Association
accrediting_body.quote: from a college or school approved by the Council on Podiatric Education of the American Podiatric Medical Association, or the successor of such Council.
accrediting_body.citation: § 508. Qualifications of applicant; report to Attorney General; judicial review.

required.quote: Has satisfactorily completed a hospital residency program approved by the Council on Podiatric Medical Education.
required.citation: § 508. Qualifications of applicant; report to Attorney General; judicial review.

kind.quote: Has satisfactorily completed a hospital residency program approved by the Council on Podiatric Medical Education.
kind.citation: § 508. Qualifications of applicant; report to Attorney General; judicial review.

exams.name: Podiatric Medical Licensing Examination for States (PMLEXIS)
exams.notes: Minimum passing score shall be that score recommended by the testing service providing the examination.
exams.quote: Has satisfactorily completed the Podiatric Medical Licensing Examination for States (PMLEXIS); the minimum passing score shall be that score recommended by the testing service providing the examination.
exams.citation: § 508. Qualifications of applicant; report to Attorney General; judicial review.

exams.name: National Board of Podiatric Medical Examiners (NBPME)
exams.notes: Designated by the Board as a written, standardized examination.
exams.quote: Designate the written, standardized examination on podiatry administered by the National Board of Podiatric Medical Examiners (NBPME) and the Podiatric Medical Licensing Examination for States (PMLEXIS), to be taken by all persons applying for licensure.

interval_years.quote: Each license shall be renewed biennially, in such manner as is determined by the Division

required.quote: proof that the licensee has met the continuing education requirements established by the Board.

available.quote: the Board shall grant a license to each applicant who shall present proof of current licensure in "good standing" in another state, the District of Columbia or territory of the United States, whose standards for licensure are substantially similar to those of this State.

requirements.value: Applicant must present proof of current licensure in good standing in another state with substantially similar standards; if standards are not substantially similar, applicant must have practiced for a minimum of 5 years after licensure.
requirements.quote: An applicant, who is licensed or registered in a state whose standards are not substantially similar to those of this State, shall have practiced for a minimum of 5 years after licensure

regulatory_model.quote: No person shall engage in the practice of podiatry or hold himself or herself out to the public in this State as being qualified to practice podiatry

title_protection.quote: use in connection with that person's name, or otherwise assume or use, any title or description conveying or tending to convey the impression that the person is qualified to practice podiatry, unless such person has been duly licensed under this chapter.

scope_protection.quote: No person shall engage in the practice of podiatry or hold himself or herself out to the public in this State as being qualified to practice podiatry

disciplinary_grounds.description: Employed or knowingly cooperated in fraud or material deception to acquire a license, impersonated a licensee, or aided unlicensed practice.
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Has employed or knowingly cooperated in fraud or material deception in order to acquire a license as a podiatrist; has impersonated another person holding a license, or allowed another person to use the podiatrist's license, or aided or abetted a person not licensed as a podiatrist to represent himself or herself as a podiatrist.

disciplinary_grounds.description: Illegally, incompetently, or negligently practiced podiatry.
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Has illegally, incompetently or negligently practiced podiatry.

disciplinary_grounds.description: Convicted of any offense substantially related to the practice of podiatry.
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Has been convicted of any offense, the circumstances of which substantially relate to the practice of podiatry.

disciplinary_grounds.description: Excessively used or abused drugs in the past 3 years or currently.
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Has excessively used or abused drugs either in the past 3 years or currently.

disciplinary_grounds.description: Engaged in consumer fraud, deception, restraint of competition, or price-fixing.
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Has engaged in an act of consumer fraud or deception; engaged in the restraint of competition; or participated in price-fixing activities.

disciplinary_grounds.description: Violated a lawful provision of this chapter or any lawful regulation established thereunder.
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Has violated a lawful provision of this chapter, or any lawful regulation established thereunder.

disciplinary_grounds.description: Had license suspended, revoked, or other disciplinary action taken in another jurisdiction for conduct constituting grounds under this chapter.
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Has had his or her license as a podiatrist suspended or revoked, or other disciplinary action taken by the appropriate licensing authority in another jurisdiction

disciplinary_grounds.description: Maintained a facility in an unsanitary or unsafe condition.
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Has maintained a facility in an unsanitary or unsafe condition.

disciplinary_grounds.description: Failed to notify the Board that the podiatrist's license in another state was subject to discipline, surrender, suspension, or revocation.
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Has failed to notify the Board that the podiatrist's license as a podiatrist in another state has been subject to discipline, or has been surrendered, suspended or revoked.

disciplinary_grounds.description: Has a physical condition such that the performance of podiatry is or may be injurious or prejudicial to the public.
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Has a physical condition such that the performance of podiatry is or may be injurious or prejudicial to the public.

citations.cite: § 508. Qualifications of applicant; report to Attorney General; judicial review.

definition_quote.value: the diagnosis and the medical, surgical, mechanical, manipulative and electrical treatment of all ailments of the foot and ankle
definition_quote.quote: "Practice of podiatry" shall mean the diagnosis and the medical, surgical, mechanical, manipulative and electrical treatment of all ailments of the foot and ankle.

methods_authorized.quote: the diagnosis and the medical, surgical, mechanical, manipulative and electrical treatment of all ailments of the foot and ankle

drug_authority.value: Podiatrists may prescribe medicine as part of medical treatment of the foot and ankle; electronic prescribing is required with limited exceptions.
drug_authority.quote: "Medical treatment" shall mean the application to or prescription for the foot and ankle of medicine, pads, adhesives, felt, plasters or any medicinal agency.

anatomical_scope_upper_boundary.quote: "Practice of podiatry" shall mean the diagnosis and the medical, surgical, mechanical, manipulative and electrical treatment of all ailments of the foot and ankle.

amputation_authorized.quote: Amputation of the foot shall be restricted to state-licensed podiatrists who have completed an American Podiatric Medical Association accredited surgical residency program acceptable to the Board and have current amputation privileges, or have fulfilled the credentialing criteria of the surgical committee of the Joint Committee on Accreditation of Hospitals accredited hospital where the amputation is to be performed.

ankle_surgery_authorized.quote: "Practice of podiatry" shall mean the diagnosis and the medical, surgical, mechanical, manipulative and electrical treatment of all ailments of the foot and ankle.

telehealth_authorized.quote: As appropriate in regulation, these services may be performed with the use of telemedicine. Podiatry may also include participation in telehealth, as further defined in regulation.

corrective_footwear_exemption.quote: This chapter shall not prohibit the fitting, recommending or sale of corrective shoes, arch supports or similar mechanical appliances by retail dealers or manufacturers.

electronic_prescribing_required.quote: no person licensed under this chapter shall issue any prescription unless such prescription is made by electronic prescription from the person issuing the prescription to a pharmacy in accordance with regulations established by the Board

office_based_surgery_accreditation_requi.quote: No person licensed under this chapter shall perform any office-based surgery, as defined in § 122(3)y. of Title 16, in a facility unless it is accredited or licensed in accordance with § 122(3)z. of Title 16.
office_based_surgery_accreditation_requi.citation: § 521. Accreditation of facilities where office-based surgeries are performed.

minor_patient_chaperone_requirement.quote: A parent, guardian or other caretaker, or an adult staff member, shall be present when a person licensed under this chapter provides outpatient treatment to a minor patient who is disrobed or partially disrobed or during an outpatient physical examination
